g.text: 06 / Operator control, observations and retained evidence
One Operator API process owns internal control/observation modules. Shopper web remains independent; controls run on the backend owner host.
Operator HTML / SVG console; pnpm CLI
Named Node owners, no duplicate ports
Local dedicated Lima or remote SSH
Host OS + local Lima / configured SSH
Never raw replay keys or credentials
APIs / owned SQL probes / queue counts
pnpm logs all · bounded local windows
Cards 1–6 are the named-control path. Cards 7–9 are independent read-only observation/viewer paths; the terminal reads the same owner windows directly.
